title: Five Ways a Test Can Lie to You
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Five paired panels, one per confounder, each showing a tilted balance scale for how it misleads and a level scale for the defense.

educational.topic: Five confounding variables in a classroom A/B test and their defenses
learningObjectives: The learner will identify the confounder in a test setup and name its defense.
prerequisites: The control group and the one-difference rule from [Chapter 16](../../chapters/16-ab-testing-design/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What else is different between the groups?
commonMisconceptions: A big difference proves the version caused it
assessmentOpportunities: Students choose which version to use. What is the confounder, and what is the defense?
One group takes the test in the morning and the other after lunch. Which confounder?
What question should you ask before trusting a difference between groups?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
